title: Lear Announces Date for First Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call
body_markdown:
SOUTHFIELD, Mich., March 31, 2026 -- Lear Corporation will hold a conference call to review the company's first quarter 2026 financial results and related matters on May 1, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. EDT.


**To participate in the conference call:**


- Webcast link:[click here](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4653203-1&h=2042530184&u=https%3A%2F%2Fir.lear.com%2Fevents-and-presentations&a=click+here)
- Toll-free calls: 877-883-0383
- International calls: 412-902-6506


The conference code is 8201618.


You also may listen to the live audio webcast of the call, in listen-only mode, on Lear's Investor Relations website at[ir.lear.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4653203-1&h=2011828855&u=https%3A%2F%2Fir.lear.com%2Fevents-and-presentations&a=ir.lear.com) . The webcast replay will be available two hours following the call.


Note: The first quarter 2026 slide presentation will be available on Lear's website before the earnings call begins on May 1, 2026.
